meta.title: Iran Update Evening Special Report, March 4, 2026

key_takeaways: Iran will continue to attempt to disrupt international shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

events.summary: UKMTO reported five maritime incidents around Hormuz on 3-4 March.
events.evidence_quote: reported five maritime security incidents in and around the Strait of Hormuz on March 3 and March 4, which were likely Iranian attacks on shipping.
